settings.heading: Two relatives, one drawer of clips.
settings.lede: We began by hand-finishing a few accessories for friends. Today the drawer holds clips, scrunchies, brushes and a small hair-care line, sold online and through large retailers.
settings.image_alt: Two relatives sorting claw clips on a table

settings.quote: “We wanted accessories that felt like a treat, and hair care that smelled like one.”
settings.note: A short note from the two relatives behind the label about how a hobby became a business.
settings.name: Founding duo
settings.image_alt: Co-founders laughing beside a rack of clips

settings.title: Bold and effortless
settings.text: Accessories should invite you to try something, then stay out of your way.

settings.title: Made for every hair type
settings.text: Clips grip thick curls and fine strands; care formulas are tested across textures.

settings.title: Vegan and cruelty-free
settings.text: No animal ingredients, no animal testing, and a third-party certification to prove it.

settings.heading: What our pieces are made from

settings.title: Plant-based acetate
settings.text: Clips are cut and polished by hand from a biodegradable material.

settings.title: Bamboo handles
settings.text: Brush bases are bamboo, with bristles chosen to be gentle on the scalp.

settings.title: Upcycled cotton
settings.text: Everyday scrunchies are sewn locally from leftover fabric.

settings.title: Charmeuse silk
settings.text: Our silk bands are cut from smooth French charmeuse.
